text: The Bureau of Economic Analysis revises U.S. fourth-quarter GDP growth to 0.7%, down from a prior 1.4% estimate. January personal consumption expenditures inflation records a 2.8% annual rate, with core PCE at 3.1% year over year. The data shows slower growth alongside elevated core inflation levels.

meta.note: GDP revision and inflation data occur within the same macroeconomic statistical release.
